{ "rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is high (>=0.67) due to lagging behind actual price corrections",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity in volatile periods by scaling sentiment impact by volatility factor",
    "Correct mean-reversion overshoot by 5-10% when model drifts 3+ days from current price",
    "Scale forecast magnitude by sentiment strength, weak sentiment (<=0.33) yields 60% of baseline forecasts",
    "Align forecast direction with recent price momentum when sentiment is neutral (0.34-0.66)",
    "Reduce forecast divergence from immediate price level when history shows rapid 2+ day moves",
    "Apply different correction weights for bullish vs bearish sentiment reversal patterns"
] }
